ai.title: thinkdeeply drops prompt arg, uses last user message
ai.summary: The think_deeply tool no longer accepts a prompt argument in its XML tag. Backend logic in main-prompt.ts and planning.ts now extracts the last user message via getMessageText and passes it directly to getRelevantFilesForPlanning and planComplexChange. This removes redundant prompt generation and ensures file context and planning steps align with the actual user request. System prompt documentation updated to reflect the empty tool signature.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to think deeply about a complex task, it used to make you restate your request in a special prompt box before doing its work. Now, instead of asking for a separate prompt, the assistant automatically picks up the last thing you said and uses that directly. You'll notice the deep-thinking process starts without the extra prompt step, and the files it examines and the plan it builds are now tied straight to your last message rather than a rewritten version of it. This makes the deep-thinking workflow simpler and more aligned with what you actually asked for.
